title: ATT&CK-Style Kill Chain Coverage Analysis of Open-Source Agent Monitoring Tools

original_idea.body:
# ATT&CK-Style Kill Chain Coverage Analysis of Open-Source Agent Monitoring Tools

**Problem:** The LW threat matrix maps a full ATT&CK-style kill chain for rogue AI, but no study has assessed which stages of that kill chain are covered (or not covered) by existing open-source monitoring tools.

**Direction:** Map the LW loss-of-control threat matrix tactics to detection capabilities of open-source agent monitoring tools (e.g., LangSmith tracing, AgentOps). Score coverage per tactic, identify gaps, and produce a coverage heatmap.

**Why it matters:** Cloud providers and developers need to know which kill-chain stages are defensible now vs. which require new tooling or partnerships — this analysis provides a concrete roadmap.

**Relevant context:** LW 2026 Loss of Control Threat Matrix; LangSmith/AgentOps open-source monitoring ecosystem.
